subject: Renewal: proposed term change to net90 + capacity increase — PO and EIN needed
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@orbitcloud.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-11T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal: proposed term change to net90 + capacity increase — PO and EIN needed

Hi Liam,

Quick note on OrbitCloud's upcoming renewal (DL-9876) — thanks again for the conversation last week. Based on your request to double committed capacity for Q3 (2.0 reserved capacity) and to move billing to a single consolidated legal entity, we scoped a renewal amendment that does two things:

- Increase reserved capacity to 2x current commit effective 2028-06-01
- Move payment terms from Net45 to Net90 to align with your treasury cadence

To get the contract amendment and invoicing started we need two items from your side: a purchase order that references DL-9876 and the legal payor EIN (or a PO that already includes the correct bill-to entity). I've attached a short renewal summary for review.

Can you confirm whether OrbitCloud will: (a) provide a PO that references "Redwood Inference, Inc. — DL-9876", or (b) supply updated legal entity details for invoice routing? If you go with a separate payor, please include the EIN and billing contact.

Requested timeline: if we can get PO + EIN by 2028-04-18 we can schedule the amendment to hit billing for June 1st. If Net90 needs additional approvals on your side, flag me and I can coordinate with our finance team to accelerate.

Attachments: renewal_summary_orbitcloud.pdf (summary + pricing table)

Thanks —
Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
